texts390.text: A solo Pepe strategy game. Harvest, build, outlast.
Build a squad. Break their base.
Crystal Basin is the last supply line. Establish your base before the enemy closes in.
Recruit Pepes. Hold the point three times or destroy their base.
5–20 minute battles. Strategic orders determine results; map movement is tactical presenta
Two factions, three difficulties, one contested basin. No multiplayer or score signer.
Recruit, Tank and Commando Pepes need buildings and ore. Harvester Pepes return to base au
Only confirmed contract battles can earn command power. Practice scores never become token
Unofficial community strategy game. Not an official IMD product.
The hosted-play link opens the Pepe2Pepe game catalog.
